Gossip update message types, tags, and payload structures.

# Purpose
This header defines the data types and message tags used by the gossip update stream. It declares the wire format for several gossip message kinds, including `fd_contact_info_t`, `fd_gossip_vote_t`, `fd_gossip_duplicate_shred_t`, and `fd_gossip_snapshot_hashes_t`, and it groups them in the `fd_gossip_update_message_t` union with a `tag` field. The file also defines limits and indexes for contact info storage, socket kinds, and client version identifiers, so consumers can decode and maintain a local view of peer state. In practice, this header serves as the shared protocol definition for gossip updates published by the gossip tile and consumed by other tiles.
